prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1247; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented for evaluation following a rear-end motor vehicle collision and reported neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and mild restriction with extension and rotation. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry. A diagnosis of cervical strain with whiplash-associated disorder was established.

Over the course of 16 visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise focused on deep neck flexor and scapular strengthening, and posture education. Pain levels decreased steadily from the initial assessment, and range of motion improved in all planes. Headache frequency diminished substantially by the middle of the treatment course. Home exercise compliance was good, and the patient reported improved sleep and ability to return to work duties.

At discharge, the patient had residual mild neck stiffness with occasional activity-related discomfort but no radicular symptoms. Continued self-directed exercise and ergonomic modifications were recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
